Pairs (x,y) are taken mod 5 over {1..5}, which covers every residue class exactly once. So f is the number of solutions in (Z/5)^2 of the linear system with matrix M = [[a,b],[c,d]] over F_5. The solution set is the kernel, a subspace of size 5^(2−rank).

- rank 2: 1 solution (only (0,0), i.e. (5,5))
- rank 1: 5 solutions
- rank 0: 25 solutions

All three ranks are achievable, so the possible values are 1, 5, 25, and their sum is 31.

ANSWER: 31
